evidence:
PASS is limited to the workbook's plausible reference coverage, not a measured Oracle/full-judge result. I read every criterion (145 Functional, 5 Polish, 5 Visual and the two gates) and found no concrete criterion that the golden cannot satisfy. The required full configured grading and exact score remain unmeasured, so risk=true and run_verdict=PARTIAL.

Functional coverage: frozen task solution/app/src/index.js:95 implements password/session login, :202-233 authenticated operational reads, :242-257 exact integer/date/economic validation, :296-326 requisition and pending-offer creation, :328-349 tier/dual-control approval with one transaction, :351-382 revisions with reversal/replacement, signed bonus adjustment and superseded grants, and :384-411 Finance rescission with release/clawback/cancellation. Role authorization resolves the session at :71-89, before those handlers. Stored-offer eligibility is checked at :286-291; all settlement rows and immutable audit/after-images are written within the transaction, with receipt construction at :278-285. rules.js:24-48 validates dates and computes original-anchor UTC completed months; :50-82 uses BigInt half-up arithmetic for intrinsic, annualization, budget run-rate and bands; :103-150 implements separate signing/equity caps and the fixed referral clock. db.js:13 and :122-126 honor DB_PATH and seed once. This supports P1-P10 including the exact arithmetic and calendar boundary criteria.

Coordinated coverage: solution/app/src/change-sets.js:13-16 versions touched requisitions by append-only ledger identity, :22-63 canonicalizes distinct 2-4 members and computes complete-set final headrooms, :77-93 saves immutable actor/key previews without settlement, and :94-147 authorizes before cached results, rejects stale touched-state/source leaves and commits all members inside an immediate transaction. After-snapshots are created after all movements at :123-138. Cached receipt return precedes current-leaf revalidation at :98; later ordinary revision/rescission uses the transferred successor's req_id. These implement B1-B6, including same-operation retries, overlap conflicts, disjoint independence, receipt preservation and post-restart replay. Local batch-domain/results.json records 15 successful finite groups; batch-boundaries/results.json adds different-source pairs sharing a requisition, all read roles, eligible draft write refusals, independent key changes, zero-unit successors and accepted safe large zero-spread units. I read the batch-domain driver assertions rather than treating a result file as self-proving.

Operator-facing evidence: public/js/hireops.js:14-35 uses exact string/BigInt money parsing and UTC date entry; :121-197 renders compensation, grants/schedules, payments, lineage and operation forms; :298-317 renders recipient/date/cliff/split referral figures; :366-415 exposes nested before/after receipts and audit text. public/js/app.js:185-222 retains the open form on failed submission. public/js/change-sets.js renders labelled member inputs and saved preview/receipt values, retains editor state after refusal, and retries the same saved commit. Local legacy-ui/results.json records large-cent unchanged-field UI round trips and rescission interruption/retry, batch-ui/results.json records stale-preview recovery and a real forwarded commit whose response was lost followed by retry with no new effects, and targeted-golden/results.json records prepare-refusal correction and visible grant/signing/referral figures. I inspected their relevant driver assertions. The local precision test uses a smaller base and does not explicitly set the criterion's one-unit input, so it is corroboration rather than execution of that exact P2 case; unconditional parsing/prefill source supports its plausibility.

Visual coverage: inspected committed-desktop.png and financial-referral.png against all five visual anchors and the source CSS. They show a legible desktop type scale, muted palette, aligned financial label/value groups, clear primary actions and consistent cards/forms. The coordinated member fieldsets are comparatively plain, so a perfect craft score is not asserted. No screenshot or source claim is treated as an actual configured visual judge score.

Counterexample assessment: a plausible broken implementation that versions previews only by current headroom could pass ordinary transfer/retry smoke checks; local batch-witnesses/results.json shows its ABA witness returning200 instead of409, while the golden passes. Removing the original-result cache returns409 instead of200 on identical retries; sequential member budgeting rejects the affordable cycle. Conversely a conforming app omitting optional operational seed history passes all 15 local batch groups, consistent with the prompt's fresh-record setups. The no-op creation fixture fails the independent-context basic gate; dead approval correctly remains outside that minimal creation gate. These are bounded local observations, not measured shaped rewards.

Hash verification: per-row-review/evidence/18/hash-verification.json records an independent SHA256 check of all 254 entries currently in raw-evidence-index.json with zero mismatches, the exact hashes of cited raw artifacts, and 82 source bindings from domain, legacy UI, batch domain/UI and targeted golden outputs matching the frozen task. install-lifecycle/results.json separately records a real restart via MCP with old PID21/new PID97 and saved-data retention. No Docker or provider run was performed for this review, and no private deterministic-suite, full configured grade, workload completion, Oracle1 or portal-pass claim is made.
